The tide pulled back as though clearing a path, and somewhere beyond the mist a bell buoy called him home.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市尚未从浅眠中醒来。高楼的灯零星亮着，像浸在雾里的星。街道被雨水洗过，倒映着霓虹与交通灯的微光。便利店透出暖黄光芒，店员轻声整理货架；环卫工沿马路牙子清扫落叶，扫帚声在空巷里格外清晰。偶尔有出租车驶过，带走一缕夜风。远处桥面上，第一班轮渡正低声鸣笛，天边已泛起青白。","w03":"- Recursion is when you solve a big problem by asking a smaller version of the same problem for help.\n- Each smaller version gets easier until you reach a simple answer that needs no more asking.\n- Then all the small answers pass back up, like nested dolls revealing one another from the inside out."}
